traditional: The body and daily needs combined with limitation and structure.

modern.blend: Emotion meets limit and duty. Emotional reserve, seriousness, and a habit of bracing for the worst.
modern.hard: Coldness or distance, pessimism, and a sense of deprivation. Useful work is the standard remedy.
modern.business: Dependable under pressure; the risk is grinding joylessly.
